notes.title: Long awaited update of Witching Tower
notes.notes:
Hey all! 

Today our team will release the last updated version of Witching Tower⚡️

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32058515/71508bcf712160b59bac71ce3bf915454fba8e25.jpg


The main features of the patch are improved combat system and improved locomotion🔥

With a new fight system, locomotion and smarter enemies, battles look more dynamic and exciting. Also our game now supports Russian language, 3dRudder and has settings of smooth turning.

In honor of this update it has an additional nice feature which is a 50% discount on Steam⚡️

Hope, you enjoy the game process. Thank you for helping to make the game more pleasant to play❤️ 

So, follow our news, and stay in touch not to miss it. Feel free to leave a feedback. Thank you for leaving a feedback and helping to make a game better!

notes.title: First update 2019 is coming❤️
Christmas patch has arrived!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Daily Magic Productions and Witching Tower team wish you Happy New Year and Merry Christmas. We hope that the upcoming 2019 year will be successful, a lot of fun and fascinating for you❤️ 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32058515/afc1b43b4a48d9940b71bdba7af00145f5c06ea1.jpg

For New Year holidays our team has prepared a Witching Tower VR update that includes the following:

Improved optimization. We worked hard and successfully improved an optimization of our game. Now the game process is more comfortable even on a low system requirements. We almost went through the whole game to achieve this result.
Fixed bug. The game had a moment in a prologue where it was possible to fall down. That bag was also fixed. 
Fixed bug. From time to time a key in a room wasn’t active. We fixed this error and now everything works correctly.
Updated Oculus version. A distance to getting an object was increased in Oculus version. Now there’s no need to squat:)

This list is much longer, but we decided to publish only important fixes.

Very important upcoming events for our Witching Tower VR to do before the New Year are: 

 Release on Oculus Store; 
 German and Russian localizations.


And in January there will be available Japanese localization. So, follow our news, and stay in touch not to miss it. Feel free to leave a feedback. Hope, that now it’s more enjoyable to play the game.

notes.title: Halloween patch!
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

Happy Halloween! Boo!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32058515/2aefa6662b09112c9a7cdd4019d5fcfcb04af840.jpg

On this Halloween holiday, we have prepared one small, but important update for you.

So what's new?

 Snap Turning. Now, when you click on the touchpad left or right, you will turn 45'.
 Controler directional locomotion. You can enable this feature in the settings.
 Fixed some not critical bugs.
 Improved optimization, but we continue to work on it.
 We also made several cosmetic changes.


We really appreciate your feedback and will continue to quickly correct errors. Feel free to write us in Community Hub discussions and social media, please keep going! We highly appreciate the time and effort you’ve put in helping us to improve the game. 

Thank you!❤️

notes.title: New release date — October, 25th
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Today we have decided to reschedule the release of the Witching Tower VR, so now it will be on October, 25th. 

It is a difficult decision and we believe that it is truly correct. Our purpose is to make the game that will be pleasant to play, without facing any problems. 

In fact, all content is ready. However, technically we still have tasks connected with an optimization. We want to provide you a comfortable playing with stable 90 FPS.

Hope for your understanding.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32058515/fad6fdbd32b169342c3bb50ea27206d447fb2354.jpg
